headline: V | A | M and Lashen Learning move into ARC-2 gold

sections.text: V | A | M rose from 25th to 9th at 76.25 (+7.36), crossing into the gold places. Lashen Learning also moved into gold, climbing from 21st to 17th at 72.92 (+3.48).
The two moves lift the cutoff for the 17 public gold places to 72.92. Public standings remain provisional.
